title_or_caption: Over 200 Neighbors Stand with the Immigrant Defense Network After Violent Federal Raid in St. Paul: 'The Brave of Us Defend Our Community'
source_summary: IDN responds to a Nov. 18 federal workplace raid in St. Paul, describing immigrant-worker detention, community observation, protest, solidarity, and a vigil/rally framed around collective defense and dignity.
